description: a pale ghostly old stonemason, a semi-transparent misty grey-blue figure, a bald head with a long white moustache, a wooden mallet resting on his shoulder, a dusty stone-cutter's apron, a faint light from within, the whole head, both shoulders and the chest drawn complete, head and shoulders portrait, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, slavic forest village fantasy, muted colours

references.usage: the spirit chosen by the author: the same bald old stonemason with the long white moustache, the wooden mallet on his shoulder and the pale grey-blue ghostly look, drawn complete, with the whole head, both shoulders and the chest, nothing missing
